correctness.rationale: Centering Gram-matrix AM-GM proves the unique volume maximum V*=8/(9sqrt3) and precisely two chiral regular tetrahedron classes modulo rotations. After fixing P1 north and P2 azimuth zero, x,y,z,phi,psi have constant density 1/(32pi^2), with exactly two maxima q+ and q-. The determinant formula D(q) yields Taylor Delta(q_+ +h)=h^T H h/2+O(||h||^3), H positive definite with leading minors 27/32,2835/4096,18225/32768,1215/4096,243/2048, hence det H=243/2048. Independent symbolic differentiation verifies the Hessian and sqrt(det) and 2*(1/32pi^2)*vol(B5)*2^(5/2)/sqrt(detH)=128sqrt3/405. Compactness excludes other near-maxima, and rescaled dominated convergence proves uniform ellipsoid shape and fair independent chirality. Examined actual checker: symbolic Hessian, numeric Cartesian determinant and nine-million finite MC trials only corroborate, they do not prove rare-event asymptotics.
